lines.text: David says the LORD has searched him, knows when he sits and rises, and understands his thoughts from afar.
If David settles by the Red Sea, even there God's right hand will hold him fast.
God knit David together in his mother's womb, and David praises Him for being fearfully and wonderfully made.
David says that if he counted God's thoughts, they would outnumber the stars.
David asks God to search him and know his heart, and to lead him in the way everlasting.
